item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 15/Feb/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a dry northeast monsoon, it will be generally fine over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. The monsoon will moderate slightly over the weekend. Temperatures will rise over the coastal areas. A replenishment of the monsoon is expected to affect the coast of southern China early to midweek next week. It will be windier and cool in the morning over the region.
